title: Chest Collect v1
description: This is a chest collection plugin without the need for signs!
body:
This is a chest collection plugin without the need for signs! 
1. Simply look at the chest and type...
-   /autocollect <all> <radius>
-   /autocollect <item> <itemname> <radius>
-   /autocollect off. 
- It's that simple!
